items.source: SPI to implement store specific extension to the repository bean definition registration process.
items.translation: SPI 将实现针对存储库 Bean 定义注册过程的特定扩展。

items.source: Callback to register additional bean definitions for a repositories root node.
items.translation: 回调方法，用于为仓库根节点注册额外的 Bean 定义。

items.source:
Callback to register additional bean definitions for a repositories root node. This usually includes
beans you have to set up once independently of the number of repositories to be created. Will be called before any
repositories bean definitions have been registered.
items.translation: 回调以注册存储库根节点的附加 Bean 定义。这通常包括必须独立于要创建的存储库数量一次性设置的 Bean。将在任何存储库 Bean 定义注册之前被调用。

items.source: the BeanRegistrationAotProcessor type responsible for contributing AOT/native configuration. Defaults to RepositoryRegistrationAotProcessor. Must not be null.
items.translation: 负责贡献 AOT/原生配置的 `BeanRegistrationAotProcessor` 类型。默认值为 RepositoryRegistrationAotProcessor。不能为 null。

items.source: configSource - RepositoryConfigurationSource encapsulating the source (XML, Annotation) of the repository configuration.
items.translation: configSource - 封装仓库配置源（XML、注解）的RepositoryConfigurationSource。

items.source: loader - ResourceLoader used to load resources.
items.translation: loader - 用于加载资源的 ResourceLoader。

items.source: registry - BeanDefinitionRegistry containing bean definitions.
items.translation: registry - 包含 Bean 定义的 BeanDefinitionRegistry。

items.source: configurationSource - RepositoryConfigurationSource encapsulating the source (e.g. XML, Annotation) of the repository configuration.
items.translation: configurationSource - 封装仓库配置源（例如 XML、注解）的RepositoryConfigurationSource接口。

items.source: strictMatchesOnly - whether to return strict repository matches only. Handing in true will cause the repository interfaces and domain types handled to be checked whether they are managed by the current store.
items.translation: strictMatchesOnly - 是否仅返回严格匹配的结果。传入 true 将导致检查当前存储所管理的仓库接口和领域类型。
